question.prompt:
After one face of a cube is designated as the base, how many faces are perpendicular to this base?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h122_q2_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: All four lateral faces contain lines perpendicular to the base (the lateral edges). By the criterion for perpendicular planes, they are all perpendicular to the base; the opposite face is parallel to the base.
solutions.title: Criterion for perpendicular planes
